about: Explicit game-database evidence for a family-level repertoire match. This supplements the GM profile's abbreviated system label; it does not infer support from player identity or opening-name similarity.

entries.basis: Chess.ceo lists 288 White games classified as Sicilian in its player database.
Chess.com lists Sicilian Defense: Canal Attack among her White openings, with 19 games.
365Chess lists 33 B51 Sicilian games; ChessBox provides a specific White B31 Sicilian game against Anastasia Bodnaruk.
